activity.notes: The Lord of Sipán is an archaeologically attested elite Moche ruler whose intact royal tomb at Huaca Rajada-Sipán contained emblems of rank, command, and military authority. Peru's Ministry of Culture dates the burial to approximately AD 600–650 and describes him as the maximum authority of his time. Because no personal reign interval or personal name survives, ATLAS uses c.625 as a representative point within the archaeological date range and binds him to Sipán's Moche political sphere rather than treating all Moche society as one centralized kingdom under him.
